annotations.text: Home board. Rail collapsed to 48px with the peek overlay open beside it - it floats over the board rather than pushing it. Tiles snap to 12 columns and 40px rows; the Projects tile is mid-drag with its snap ghost behind it.

Widget workspace - the interactive one. The five panel buttons in the header toggle Files, Diff, Terminal, Artifacts and Context; whatever is left reflows to fill. This is the piece you drew, and it needs no docking library.

Lifecycle board. Columns are what a run is doing, not what someone dragged it to: Working / Needs You / In Review / Done are projections of lifecycle + control, which farseer already stores. Workers sit indented under their manager.
Chrome and tokens. Status bar anatomy and its three states, the rail's four zones, and every colour lifted from ui/src/style.css rather than re-picked.
